fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. Uses one unified remote scene-anchor pipeline for physical furniture, free-standing and wall scenes, with synchronized participant alignment, scene controls and NPC undressing. v0.33.5 keeps the validated PPA synchronization from v0.33.3 and extends the remote OCum overlay repair: after the coalesced RaceMenu proxy overlay reinstall, OStim Together performs a bounded transform-and-world-bound refresh so newly attached Body [OvlN] geometry inherits the proxy's current scene-graph spatial state.
